relations: Vigorous boiling generates bubbles that rise and burst across the pan floor around both submerged phones.
White foam and bubble clusters outline and shift along the edges of the right white phone.
The left dark phone keeps its lit screen while bubbles drift across the right phone's black screen.
Both phones stay in arrangement with slight jiggle as the pan rim and handle shift from handheld camera motion.
caption: The video depicts a round cooking pan with a dark maroon interior and metallic rim, filled with a liquid that boils vigorously. Two smartphones lie submerged side by side in the bubbling liquid. On the left, a dark phone keeps its screen lit, showing a bright white notification box above a dock of four app icons, the leftmost a green call symbol. To its right, a white phone rests at a diagonal with its screen black and its round home button visible at the lower end. Energetic bubbles form across the pan floor, rise, and burst, while white foam and clinging clusters outline and shift along the edges of the right phone. Bubbles and foam drift across that dark screen as the liquid churns. Both devices stay in essentially the same arrangement, jiggling only slightly, while the pan's rim and the intermittent metal handle at the left edge move subtly within the frame, indicating small handheld camera motion.
